text:
sara: Hey team — prepping the pen-test retest for the payment flow (ACME). Proposed slot: Wed 2026-04-01 10:00-14:00 PDT. Need a quick ops checklist: RBAC changes, KMS access window, audit log export, evidence handoff, and oncall roster. Who can own coordination?

matt: I can own the oncall side. Need list of exact permission deltas we plan to apply (principals + duration).

sara: Thanks. Minimal change plan: create ephemeral role 'assessor_ephemeral' with these perms: kms:Decrypt (on assessment-key), logs:DescribeLogStreams, logs:GetLogEvents, s3:GetObject (evidence bucket). TTL 4h. We'll rotate creds after window.

olivia: For KMS access we should use an IAM condition that restricts by aws:SourceIp (assessor VPN) + aws:TokenIssueTime < window_end. Also prefer granting via our access-proxy so we don't hand out long-lived keys.

raj: I can template the terraform snippet. Example we used last time:
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "assessor_ephemeral" {
  name = "assessor_ephemeral"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assessor.json
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "assessor_limits" {
  policy = jsonencode({
    "Statement" = [{"Action" = ["kms:Decrypt","logs:GetLogEvents","s3:GetObject"], "Effect" = "Allow", "Resource" = "*"}]
  })
}
```
We'll add conditions for source IP and a tag ttl.

sara: Perfect. For audit evidence: we need CloudTrail export covering the last 7 days + live tail during test. Please pre-generate a 7-day bucket export and create a presigned URL for the assessor. We also need filtered CloudWatch Logs for the payment API lambda group.

matt: I'll schedule the export job and ensure SIEM ingestion. ETA 24h. For presigned URLs we'll use 8-hour expiry and store the link in the read-only evidence vault (no posting in public channels).

olivia: One gotcha: when we enable ephemeral roles via STS, the KMS decrypt call will show up with the STS principal — capture that mapping in the evidence manifest. Add a mapping file with: principal_arn -> ephemeral_token_id.

sara: Good call. Also need to document rollback steps in case retest triggers a false positive or service regression: 1) revoke assessor_ephemeral via iam:RevokeSession 2) detach policy 3) clear presigned URLs 4) rotate assessment-key if any misuse. Keep rollback playbook < 10 minutes.

raj: I'll add a small runbook in repo: ops/pt-retest/rollbacks.md and include run commands. Quick commands:
```bash
# revoke sessions
aws iam revoke-sessions --role-name assessor_ephemeral
# detach policy
aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name assessor_ephemeral --policy-arn $POLICY_ARN
```

sara: Who from product or legal do we need in the reading room? We might need an oncall product engineer to validate false positives and legal to confirm scope.

matt: Add @jordan-prod and @maria-legal to the invite. I'll ping them in the calendar invite.

security-bot: Reminder: submit retest scope + evidence checklist to the assessment tracker: https://tracker.redwood.internal/assessments/ACME-2026. Required fields: start_time, end_time, roles_created, kms_key_id, evidence_bucket.

olivia: One more technical note — audit log sampling. If the assessor is heavy on log pulls, we should bump CloudWatch retention to 30d for the payment lambda and ensure Export snapshots are consistent. Also enable log group resource-based policy so assessor can't delete logs.

sara: Thanks. Action items: matt = oncall & evidence export (ETA 24h), raj = terraform role + rollback doc (ETA 8h), olivia = KMS condition + log policies (ETA 12h), sara = calendar + assessor handshake. I'll mark in tracker and ping legal/product.

matt: I'll also patch the monitor to alert if unexpected KMS use outside the retest window.

raj: Uploaded draft PR: https://git.redwood/ops/pt-retest/pull/42 — includes role, policy, and rollback. Requesting review from olivia and sara.

sara: LGTM — once PR merges, we'll run a dry-run tomorrow at 11:00 to validate the session creation and evidence bundle.

security-bot: Status update recorded: retest scheduled, artifacts requested. Next automated reminder in 48h.
